summary: Compile uncached after bounded pre-compile cache startup failures and isolate boundary-test Cargo metadata from runner cache settings.

replay.detail: CI only; no replay or rebuild of runtime state.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or authority rules change.

compatibility.detail: Known preflight startup failures compile uncached. Compiler and compatibility-test verdicts stay authoritative; compilation is never retried from stderr or interruption.

manual.detail: Normal hosted CI picks up the shell and guard changes.
